atoms.a:
James would like to buy himself a new games console, which costs £386.99, and a pair of headphones, which cost £13.
His parents have offered to pay a third of the cost.

How much will his parents pay?
James has already saved up £140.54. How much more does he have left to save up?
atoms.b:
Cost after parents’ help: £399.99-£133.33=£266.66

Cost after subtracting James’ savings:£266.66-£140.54=£126.12
James still needs to save up <mat>£<gap>126.12</gap></mat>.

atoms.a:
James’s uncle says that he will pay a third of the remaining cost.

How much will James now have left to save up?

atoms.b: James now has <mat>£<gap>84.08</gap></mat> left to save up.
